purpose: Second horror/ecology expansion: additional cannibal horde forms, necromancers, eldritch entities, demons, mythical creatures, mega-bosses, and post-target world events.

entities.name: Gravegnawer

identity.fantasy: A fast corpse-eater that grows stronger by consuming fallen members of its own pack; it is the first stage of the Devouring Line.
identity.silhouette: Lean hairless humanoid with split jaw, overlong forearms, and pale ember veins.
identity.lore_hook: The horde does not bury its dead because death is considered unfinished nutrition.

signature: Devour Kindred lets a Gravegnawer consume a fallen horde body to gain temporary speed and armor.
Feeding near another Gravegnawer starts a violent contest that briefly distracts both.
counterplay: Destroy or deny corpses, kite packs away from feeding sites, punish the long feeding crouch.
evolution: Escalation changes behavior trees, resource rules, and encounter geometry rather than simply multiplying health.

vfx: Pale veins brighten during feeding.
Consumed corpse dissolves into ash ribbons rather than lingering.
animation: Low four-limb sprint.
Feeding animation hunches over a corpse and snaps upright violently.
audio: Jaw clicks, wet growls, escalating heartbeat.

notes: Authored for AEONFALL wave 011. Large forms must use streaming-safe shells and distributed controllers where required.

entities.name: Carrion Ascendant

identity.fantasy: A Gravegnawer that survived enough feedings to grow armored bone ridges and command lesser feeders through scent bursts.
identity.silhouette: Broad predatory frame with spinal bone fins and sealed lower face.
identity.lore_hook: The second stage remembers where food was found and teaches the pack to return.

signature: Scent Brand marks a corpse cluster and redirects nearby tier-I horde units toward it.
Bone Rush shoulder-charges players who interrupt a feed.
Overfed State briefly hardens bone fins and reduces stagger.
counterplay: Scent Brands are visible; breaking corpse clusters denies growth; Overfed State has a slow turning rate.
evolution: Escalation changes behavior trees, resource rules, and encounter geometry rather than simply multiplying health.

vfx: Red scent ribbons stream from branded corpses.
Bone fins glow from within during Overfed State.
animation: Command posture arches spine fins outward.
Bone Rush drops to all fours before impact.
audio: Deep scent bellow, bone clatter, low charge roar.

method: Evolves from tier-I horde state during sustained outbreaks.

notes: Authored for AEONFALL wave 011. Large forms must use streaming-safe shells and distributed controllers where required.

entities.name: Marrow Apostle

identity.fantasy: A towering third-stage devourer that ritualizes cannibalism, converting consumed kin into temporary mutations chosen by battlefield need.
identity.silhouette: Twelve-foot gaunt giant with rib-cage crown and three asymmetrical arms.
identity.lore_hook: At the third stage the horde stops merely eating and begins choosing what it wants to become.

signature: Consume Runner grants burst mobility.
Consume Brute grants temporary plated limbs.
Consume Screamer grants a sonic cone.
Consume Necrotic grants a short corruption aura.
Apostolic Call forces nearby lower tiers to stop feeding and attack one marked target.
counterplay: Only one mutation can be active; mutation tells are visible in silhouette; corpse denial remains effective.
evolution: Escalation changes behavior trees, resource rules, and encounter geometry rather than simply multiplying health.

vfx: Rib crown changes shape per mutation.
Consumed essence spirals into one specific limb.
Call paints a blood-red target glyph visible to players.
animation: Each mutation physically rearranges one body region.
Call uses the smaller third arm to point while main arms brace.
audio: Layered throat voices, rib creaks, mutation-specific stingers.

method: Rare evolution during mature horde events.

notes: Authored for AEONFALL wave 011. Large forms must use streaming-safe shells and distributed controllers where required.

entities.name: Corpse Basilica

identity.fantasy: A collective fourth-stage organism formed when dozens of devourers merge into a mobile fortress that breeds temporary attack bodies from its own mass.
identity.silhouette: Building-sized crawling cathedral of fused bone arches, limbs, and hanging cocoon chambers.
identity.lore_hook: The fourth stage is no longer an individual. It is where the horde begins constructing itself.

signature: Basilica Mass can be shifted between armor, movement, or spawn output.
Cocoon Nave produces temporary lesser attackers until its chamber is destroyed.
Procession Legs can anchor into the ground to become a siege nest.
Hunger Bell draws nearby lower-tier horde bodies toward the Basilica for absorption.
counterplay: Destroy cocoon chambers and leg anchors; absorbed bodies are vulnerable while traveling toward the Basilica.
evolution: Escalation changes behavior trees, resource rules, and encounter geometry rather than simply multiplying health.

vfx: Bone-arch silhouette visible from extreme distance.
Cocoons pulse with different spawn colors.
Anchoring grows a ring of rib-like buttresses.
animation: Whole structure moves like a slow centipede church.
Anchoring unfolds legs into structural columns.
Destroyed chambers collapse inward before sealing.
audio: Cathedral groans, distant bell made from bone resonance, many muffled snarls.

method: Event-only evolution from an unchecked tier-III horde.

notes: Authored for AEONFALL wave 011. Large forms must use streaming-safe shells and distributed controllers where required.

entities.name: Crowned Hunger

identity.fantasy: The fifth and final horde evolution: a god-scale predator-mind that consumes its own swarm to create specialized limbs, armor organs, and temporary avatars across a region.
identity.silhouette: Colossal crown-headed silhouette with multiple city-block appendages emerging from a moving horde mass.
identity.lore_hook: The final stage does not command the horde. The horde realizes it has always been one organism.

signature: Royal Consumption sacrifices active lower-tier horde units to grow one authored combat organ.
Legion Hand manifests a temporary giant limb in a targeted region.
Maw Avatar spawns a smaller controllable boss-body while the core remains distant.
Hunger Weather creates a regional red ash storm that changes horde behavior.
Crown Pulse synchronizes all surviving horde units into one attack cadence.
counterplay: Every apex organ exposes corresponding weak points; consuming the horde reduces its field presence; coordinated teams can force inefficient organ choices.
evolution: Escalation changes behavior trees, resource rules, and encounter geometry rather than simply multiplying health.

vfx: A crown of moving red-black silhouettes appears in the sky above the active region.
Giant limb manifestations rise from swarms rather than teleporting in.
Ash storm contains faint jaw-shaped vortices.
Weak organs glow with distinct anatomy colors.
animation: Core silhouette slowly reconfigures when organs are purchased.
Legion Hand uses multi-stage emergence to telegraph impact.
Maw Avatar peels away from the main mass in a dramatic birth-like split.
audio: Regional heartbeat, thousands of synchronized footfalls, crown-tone horn.

method: Only appears after a full five-stage horde escalation event.

notes: Authored for AEONFALL wave 011. Large forms must use streaming-safe shells and distributed controllers where required.

identity.silhouette: A broken triangular silhouette that seems flatter from some directions and enormous from others.

Right Angle Leap lets it emerge from an eligible corner.

Reflex Collapse briefly flattens into a harmless plane after a failed ambush.

evolution: Escalation changes behavior trees, resource rules, and encounter geometry rather than simply multiplying health.

entities.name: Velvet Horn Temptress

Second Promise places a decoy refuge with a different timer.

entities.name: Hellclock Auditor

identity.silhouette: Thin red-black clerk with six clock faces embedded in torso.

Completing Contract grants a brief boon.

evolution: Escalation changes behavior trees, resource rules, and encounter geometry rather than simply multiplying health.

Penalty Bell sends red rings across the floor.

entities.name: Vermilion Contract Devil

identity.fantasy: A demon boss that offers optional combat contracts mid-fight; accepting gives power but adds new obligations and failure penalties.
identity.silhouette: Tall red legalist demon with burning scroll wings.
identity.lore_hook: It has never broken a promise because every promise was written to hurt someone.

signature: Offer Contract choices during safe intermissions.
Contract of Fury boosts damage but demands constant aggression.
Contract of Mercy boosts support but punishes ally neglect.
Contract of Motion boosts mobility but punishes standing still.

counterplay: Players may refuse every contract; reading clauses and choosing team-suitable risks is key.
